Battling not only other competitors but also extreme heat at the annual Nathan’s ⁠Famous Hot Dog Eating Contest in New York City’s ‌Coney Island, Chestnut scored his ​18th Mustard Belt win by downing 66 hot dogs. Chestnut, who ate 70.5 dogs at the 2025 event, said the historic ⁠heat pummeling much of the ‌East Coast kept ‌him from making a run at his own record of 76, ⁠set in 2021.
